patch_description: This approach converts a target maximum KVPR into a bin-packing feasibility problem. For a KVPR target `T`, every model has transformed size `pressure + T * model_size`, and each GPU has capacity `T * GPU_MEM_SIZE`. A placement is feasible exactly when these transformed sizes fit in the GPU capacities. The algorithm binary-searches the best target using diversified best-fit packings, then applies move and swap improvements to the resulting placements. This directly optimizes the minimax KVPR objective rather than only balancing current ratios greedily.
